result:
I ran all 14 queries and each one gave a plausible answer, but I didn't check any against the raw data by hand. The answers were:

- T1: 4
- T2: alice, carol, erin, ivan
- T3: US 3, DE 2, FR 2, unknown 2
- T4: 33.17
- T5: bug, feature, performance, tests, urgent
- T6: 106 (carol), 102 (null), 108 (null)
- T7: alice 3, bob 1
- T8: eslint, express, jest, typescript, zod, each with its caret version
- T9: "auth,reports,search"
- T10: db 3, api 1, worker 1
- T11: 330.2
- T12: 204.91
- T13: Birch 109.97, Acme 104.96
- T14: elderberry-banana-cherry-apple-date-kiwi-fig

Two of the queries are workarounds you might not expect. In T8, `print | drop 1` strips the leading colon from each key, because `entries` returns keys as keywords and `append` doesn't work on them. In T3, T10 and T13 the result maps use keyword keys, which qlang prints with a colon (`:db`). I didn't pipe those through `json`, so I didn't see them as plain JSON object keys.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | map ~(/name) | sort ~(lower)
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | map ~(count)
T4: /data/users | map ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(type | ne ::null) | avg | round 2
T5: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map ~(/labels | map ~(/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
T6: | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~({:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce null | at :login | coalesce null)})
T7: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | coalesce null | at :login | coalesce null | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count)
T8: :dev /devDependencies | /dependencies | union dev | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~([(/0 | print | drop 1) /1]) | sort ~(/0) | map ~(join "@")
T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | coalesce false) (/port | gt 8000)) | map ~(/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: | lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | /2) | map ~(count)
T11: | lines | map ~(split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: | lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/4 | ne "") (/5 | lower | eq "shipped")) | map ~({:q (/3 | parseJson) :p (/4 | parseJson)} | mulOf /q /p) | sum | round 2
T13: | lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/4 | ne "") (/5 | lower | ne "cancelled")) | map ~({:c /1 :t ({:q (/3 | parseJson) :p (/4 | parseJson)} | mulOf /q /p)}) | groupBy ~(/c) | map ~(map ~(/t) | sum | round 2) | entries | map ~({:customer (/0 | print | drop 1) :total /1}) | sort ~([(/total | desc)]) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
